resources.string: Locuvi
Connect to a computer or server

Normally Locuvi keeps your records on this phone, and Settings › Sync keeps them in step with your other devices.\n\nIf you\'d rather use the Locuvi on your computer (with \"Let my phone and tablet connect\" switched on) or on your own server, enter its address. You\'ll find it there under Settings › Phones, tablets and computers.

Install this update by hand, once

This version is signed with Locuvi\'s new permanent key, so Android can\'t install it over the one you have. First sync, or save Everything in one file (Settings › Sync and backup file). Then uninstall Locuvi, install the new version from the website, and join sync again. After that, updates install with one tap.
